# Interesting AI Creative Projects (March 2023 onwards)

## Music & Audio
- **OpenAI's Jukebox successor work** – AI generating coherent multi-minute musical pieces with specific styles
- **Google MusicLM** – Text-to-music generation producing high-quality instrumental tracks
- **AI-generated soundtracks** for indie films and games, reducing production costs significantly

## Visual Art & Film
- **Runway's Gen-2** – Text-to-video generation used in actual short films and music videos
- **Avatar sequels' use of AI** for effects optimization and design exploration
- **AI concert visuals** – Projection mapping and real-time generative visuals at live events
- **Portrait generation projects** exploring AI bias and representation through art installations

## Interactive & Gaming
- **AI dungeon masters** for D&D-style games with dynamic storytelling
- **Video game NPCs** with substantially more nuanced dialogue and behavior
- **Procedural world generation** becoming more sophisticated and creative

## Writing & Narrative
- **Interactive fiction** blending human authorship with AI co-writing
- **Experimental poetry projects** using transformer models in surprising ways
- **Graphic novel collaborations** combining AI illustration with human storytelling

## Notable Themes
The most interesting work has generally **avoided simple automation** and instead used AI as a creative partner—amplifying human intention rather than replacing it.

What specific domain interests you most?
